faq.q: Which elementary school is in Holly?
faq.a: Holly Elementary (K–7), at 4625 62 St, Delta, on the BC Ministry of Education's SD37 school list. Whether a specific Holly address is in its catchment must be checked in the SD37 locator — catchments are address-based.

faq.q: Is Holly an official City of Delta planning area?
faq.a: This file does not treat it as one. Holly is the MLS sub-area name on the live page; the governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, Bylaw No. 8400 — a single consolidated plan with land-use designations in its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5) and no area-plan schedule for this part of Ladner.

faq.q: How do Holly residents reach the Canada Line?
faq.a: By TransLink route 601 from Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station, via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.
